title: Member Services Training Notes on the Appeals and Grievances Case File and Evidence
content:
Access to the case file, the right to present evidence and testimony, and the rules on who may file for the member apply to every **Appeals and Grievances** case.

## Rule

The member may have the case file free of charge within the case type's case-file period of asking and may present evidence and testimony until the case type's evidence cutoff point. Evidence is accepted only while the case is in filed, acknowledged or under review status. Someone other than the member files only with a signed authorized representative form, and a provider files an appeal only with the member's written consent where the case type allows a provider to file with consent.

## Questions answered

**Is there a charge for the case file?**
No. The case file is free of charge, and it is sent within the case type's case-file period counted from the member's request.

**Until when is evidence accepted?**
Until the case type's evidence cutoff point, and in any event only while the case is filed, acknowledged or under review. The status is read from the plan's record of that case, before the evidence is accepted.

**What is recorded when evidence arrives?**
Each submission is recorded with the date it was received, who submitted it and the number of documents received.

**Can a relative file for the member?**
Only with a signed authorized representative form.

**Can the treating provider file an appeal for the member?**
Only with the member's written consent, and only on a case type that allows a provider to file with consent.

## Status and evidence (derived from the rule)

| Status of the case | Evidence accepted |
|---|---|
| Filed | Yes |
| Acknowledged | Yes |
| Under review | Yes |
| Resolved | No |
| Withdrawn | No |
